1.why: WorkoutsScreen adds a Button showing attach_photo/change_photo text wired to onAttachPhoto.

2.why: OnAttachPhotoClick sends PickPhoto effect; Route calls rememberPhotoPicker launcher (PickVisualMedia/FileDialog/UIImagePickerController).

3.why: Picked bytes go to repository.attachWorkoutPhoto, which writes to filesDir/workout-photos (Android), ~/.workouts-app/photos (JVM), Documents (iOS).

4.why: WorkoutEntity gains photoPath column (v2 auto-migration, schema 2.json) and dao.updatePhotoPath stores the written file path.

5.why: File write happens in DefaultWorkoutsRepository via writeWorkoutPhotoFile, called inside withContext(ioDispatcher) from the ViewModel, not from a composable.

6.why: Screen text uses string resources, but the JVM picker adds a hard-coded user-visible dialog title "Select photo".
